messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired - METRICS: metering_ingest_lag (P1) for project 'metering-ingest' - symptom: consumer-checksum-drift > threshold. Pager: metering-ingest-team.

pagerduty: Incident 24678 triggered, escalation policy: metering-oncall. Attempting auto-notify.

Alex (oncall): Acked. I'm on it. Starting triage.

Mike (sre): Quick check - kafka partition lag spiked ~20m ago. Running consumer lag query now:```sql
SELECT sum(lag) as total_lag FROM consumer_lag WHERE consumer='metering-consumer' AND ts > now() - interval '1 hour';
```

Mike (sre): result ~ 420k msgs backlog, but more worrying: ~3% of messages flagged with checksum_mismatch in decoder logs. Pasting tail of decoder logs:```
[2026-03-14T01:17:02Z] ERROR decode: checksum_mismatch id=abc123 stream=ingest-07
[2026-03-14T01:17:02Z] WARN  parser: dropped 7 msgs from batch
```

Sara (billing): Which customers? Are we missing token counts that would affect invoices? I can surface a list and assess invoice risk.

Mike (sre): Pulling a quick aggregation by customer from the lag-counters. Preliminary: 12 customers have >= 10k token units impacted, 3 customers > 50k. I'll paste sample IDs in a sec.

Nate (product): If invoices are missing tokens, we may need manual invoice holds so customers don't get shorted or double-billed. Sara, do you want the raw customer list?

Sara (billing): Yes please. Also flag any Enterprise accounts first (contracted).

Mike (sre): Sample extract: ```text
cust-42 (ent), cust-107, cust-88, cust-512 (ent), cust-999, cust-113
```

pagerduty: Alert escalated to secondary after 2m with no resolution.

Alex (oncall): Hypothesis: decoder upgrade pushed yesterday introduced a subtle change in framing -> checksum drift. Rolling consumer back to previous image to stop new mismatches. Command:```bash
kubectl -n metering set image deploy/metering-consumer consumer=registry.redwood/metering-consumer:2026-03-13-rc2
```

Mike (sre): Rolling now. Watching consumer logs. If rollback succeeds, backlog will start to reprocess cleanly; if not, we may need to spin a compat consumer with tolerant decoder to rehydrate.

Jess (eng-lead): I'm joining. Tag me for major-customer impact. Alex, what's ETA on rollback completion?

Alex (oncall): Rolling pods terminating. New pods with rc2 coming up. ETA ~4m to steady-state.

Mike (sre): Noted that some messages already failed and were dropped by the decoder; need to backfill from raw topic for those message ranges. I'll open a backfill job (kafka-replay) once pods are stable. Command I'll run:```bash
./tools/kafka-replay --topic metering.raw --from-offset 1234567 --to-offset 1237890 --consumer-group backfill-metering-1953
```

Sara (billing): Based on current numbers, invoices for billing cycle ending today could undercount up to ~0.7% platform-wide, but for the 3 large customers it's material (~$3k-$8k). Recommend placing those 3 on invoice-hold until we confirm backfill.

Nate (product): Agreed. Notify accounts team? I'll draft a short note.

Jess (eng-lead): OK. Alex, Mike - coordinate the backfill plan and expected time to recovery (TTR). Also prepare a short post-incident summary for CS and Finance.

Alex (oncall): Pods stable, old image running. Metrics show decoder_mismatch dropped to 0. Starting kafka-replay after verifying offsets. Backfill job queued.

incident-bot: backfill job queued: backfill-1953456789-01, owner=mike.sre

Mike (sre): Backfill in progress. Streaming replay at ~8k msgs/s. ETA to drain backlog estimate ~45m. Progress snippet:```text
progress: 12% (52k/420k) replayed. errors: 0
```

pagerduty: Pager update: incident assigned to Jess (lead) for coordination.

Sara (billing): Putting cust-512, cust-42, cust-113 on invoice-hold now (manual hold flag set). Notifying Finance to delay invoice generation by 24h.

Nate (product): Sent note to accounts (cc: CS) so they can expect the follow-up. Template used: "We're holding invoice generation due to metering ingestion issue; we'll follow up with corrected usage within 24h".

Alex (oncall): Handing off monitoring to Linda (next oncall) in ~20m when I sign off. I'll leave the runbook steps in the incident doc.

Linda (next-oncall): Ack. I'll take after your sign-off. Please share the runbook link.

Alex (oncall): Runbook: https://internal.redwood/ops/runbooks/metering-ingest-checksum-drift - includes rollback, backfill commands, and verify queries.

Mike (sre): Backfill update: 60% complete, throughput stable. No new checksum errors observed post-rollback.

Sara (billing): Early verification: token counts for a sample of affected customers now match expected after reprocessing some partitions. I'm running a full reconciliation now; ETA ~30m.

Jess (eng-lead): Good. Can we estimate customer-visible downtime window for notifications? Nate/Sara, propose: "metering reports delayed ~ 1.5 hours; invoices delayed up to 24h for affected accounts." Thoughts?

Nate (product): That message looks good. Keep it conservative.

pagerduty: Incident severity reduced to P2 after backfill started and fix deployed.

Mike (sre): Backfill complete. Verification query:```sql
SELECT sum(tokens_lost) FROM reconciliation WHERE incident='1953456789';
```
result: 0 (after reprocessing).

Sara (billing): Reconciliation finished. All customer counts reconciled. Removed invoice-hold for cust-113 and cust-42; cust-512 had a separate contract change, Finance will confirm before final release.

Alex (oncall): Signing off now, handing to Linda. Key actions for night: watch consumer error rate, validate no regression in decoder tests, verify scheduled invoices run OK.

Linda (next-oncall): Taking over. Thx Alex. I'll keep an eye for 2hrs and then close.

Jess (eng-lead): Great work everyone. Please add a short timeline and root cause note (decoder framing change) to the incident doc. I'll own the RCA follow-up.

incident-bot: PagerDuty incident 24678 - resolved by Jess at 1953460389. Summary: decoder upgrade caused checksum drift -> rollback + kafka-replay backfill -> reconciliation complete.

Sara (billing): Notifying Finance & CS that reconciliation complete and invoices can proceed. :white_check_mark:

Nate (product): Sending final customer note in 10m. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
